name: Selection default kept twice
problem: The default implementation of a solution is written in the selection table and again in the records, and only a check holds the two equal. Choosing a winner means editing both, and a mismatch fails the build.
who_has_it: Developers who embed the esoi package and keep a selection table, and whoever promotes a winner.
why_it_matters: Two copies of one decision are upkeep: the default that runs and the recorded one drift, and the recorded one is the one the metric decides.
why_hard: The table is read in other people's running code, which may not ship the records, so the default has to reach it some way other than a second hand-kept copy.
existing_attempts: Defaults repeated in configuration per environment; feature-flag services; a check that compares the copies.
